channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Collin's coach: How Morikawa stayed in the moment, tips for ams
item.description: Collin Morikawa's coach Rick Sessinghaus joined "Golf Today" to talk about his student's victory at Pebble Beach and the patience it took to end a 28-month drought. He also offered up some advice to amateurs.

item.title: Ryder Cup captaincy: Tiger Woods has been asked by PGA, but no decision yet
item.description: Woods said Tuesday at Riviera, site of this week’s Genesis Invitational, that the PGA of America has reached out to him about the captaincy, though no decision has been made.

item.title: Tiger Woods doesn't rule out possible return at Masters Tournament
item.description: Tiger Woods gave a health update Tuesday at the Genesis Invitational. When asked if the Masters was off the table, he had a succinct answer.

item.title: Mom and dad provided motivation and support for Tiger
item.description: As the TGR Foundation celebrates its 30th anniversary, Tiger Woods talks about how his mom and dad gave him both motivation and support in his career and life.

item.title: Woods updates on possible 2027 U.S. Ryder Cup captaincy
item.description: Tiger Woods said the PGA of America has reached out about his captaining the U.S. in the 2027 Ryder Cup. Here's what he had to say regarding his response.

item.title: Tiger returning at the Masters? It's not off the table
item.description: Tiger Woods hasn't played on the PGA Tour since 2024. Could he return at the Masters in April. He offered a succinct answer in his Genesis Invitational press conference.

item.title: Ludvig Åberg takes advantage of new rule on replacing damaged drivers
item.description: Ludvig Åberg and caddie Joe Skovron are part of a small slice of rules history. They were the first to take advantage of the 2026 rules update that allows for a damaged club to be replaced on the spot.

item.title: Genesis Invitational 2026: First-round tee times, groupings and how to watch
item.description: Tee times, groupings and how to watch the first round of the Genesis Invitational at Riviera Country Club.

item.title: Genesis Invitational 2026: Second-round tee times, groupings and how to watch
item.description: Tee times, groupings and how to watch the second round of the Genesis Invitational at Riviera Country Club.

item.title: Full press conference: Woods putting in work on Tour schedule
item.description: Tiger Woods met with the media Tuesday at the Genesis Invitational, where he talked about everything from his playing schedule to the future of the PGA Tour's overall schedule to where his tournament fits in it all.
